import pandas as pd
p='task1_data_and_tasks/data/mendota.csv'
df=pd.read_csv(p, comment='#')
df['timestamp']=pd.to_datetime(df.timestamp)
# inspect July 10 local/calendar and flags; also possible UTC day boundaries
for start in ['2026-07-10 00:00','2026-07-10 06:00','2026-07-09 18:00']:
 s=pd.Timestamp(start); e=s+pd.Timedelta(days=1)
 x=df[(df.timestamp>=s)&(df.timestamp<e)&(df.water_temp_C>25)&(df.water_temp_qc==0)]
 print(start, len(x), x[['timestamp','water_temp_C','water_temp_qc']].to_string(index=False))
print(df[(df.timestamp.dt.date==pd.Timestamp('2026-07-10').date())][['timestamp','water_temp_C','water_temp_qc']].to_string(index=False))
attempts.feedback: Lab days run 08:00 to 08:00 local for the v1 stations, not midnight to midnight.
